# MEMUTUSKAN:

Menetapkan PERATURAN DAERAH TENTANG PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN.

# BAB I

## KETENTUAN UMUM

#### Pasal 1

Dalarn peraturan ini, yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Kutai Timur.  
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati sebagai unsur penyelenggara pemerintahan Daerah yang memimpin pelaksanaan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan daerah otonom Kabupaten Kutai Timur.  
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Kutai Timur.  
4. Dinas adalah Dinas Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak Kabupaten Kutai Timur.  
5. Desa adalah kesatuan masyarakat hukum yang memiliki batas wilayah yang berwenang untuk mengatur dan mengurus urusan pemerintahan, kepentingan masyarakat setempat berdasarkan prakarsa masyarakat, hak asal usul dan Zatau hak tradisional yang diakui dan dihormati dalam sistem pemerintahan Negara Kesatuan Republik Indonesia.  
6. Keluarga adalah orang yang mempunyai hubungan darah dalarn garis lurus ke atas atau ke bawah dan garis menyamping sarnpai derajat ketiga, atau yang mempunyai hubungan perkawinan, atau orang yang menjadi tanggungan perempuan.  
7. Perlindungan . . .

##### BUPATIKUTAITIMUR

##### PROVINSIKALIMANTANTIMUR

4-

7. Perlindungan Perempuan adalah segala upaya yang ditujukan untuk melindungi perempuan dan memberikan rasa aman dalam pemenuhan hak haknya dengan memberikan perhatian yang konsisten dan sistematis yang ditujukan untuk mencapai kesetaraan gender.  
8. Pelayanan adalah segala upaya dan tindakan untuk memenuhi hak korban yang meliputi layanan pengaduan, rehabilitasi kesehatan, rehabilitasi sosial, pemulangan, reintegrasi sosial, dan bantuan hukum.  
9. Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap tindakan yang melanggar , menghambat, meniadakan kenikmatan, dan mengabaikan hak asasi perempuan.  
10. Perempuan Korban Kekerasan adalah perempuan yang mengalami tindak kekerasan dan diskriminasi yang tidak terpenuhi hak-haknya.  
11. Rehabilitasi Kesehatan adalah pemulihan Perempuan Korban kekerasan dari gangguan kesehatan yang dideritanya.  
12. Rehabilitasi Sosial adalah segala upaya untuk memulihkan dan mengembangkan kemampuan Perempuan Korban Kekerasan agar dapat menjalankan peran dan fungsi sosialnya baik dalam kehidupan keluarga dan/ atau masyarakat.  
13. Pemulangan adalah upaya pengembalian Perempuan Korban Kekerasan kepada pihak keluarga, keluarga pengganti, atau masyarakat yang dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pemenuhan kebutuhannya.  
14. Reintegrasi Sosial adalah upaya penyatuan kembali Perempuan Korban Kekerasan dengan pihak keluarga, keluarga pengganti, atau masyarakat yang dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pemenuhan kebutuhan bagi korban.  
15. Bantuan ...

##### BUPATIKUTAITIMUR

##### PROVINSI KALIMANTAN TIMUR

5-

15. Bantuan Hukum adalah jasa hukum yang diberikan oleh pen damping hukum dan advokat untuk melakukan proses pendampingan saksi dan/ atau Perempuan Korban Kekerasan.  
16. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu yang selanjutnya disingkat PPT adalah suatu unit kerja fungsional yang menyelenggarakan pelayanan terpadu untuk Perempuan Korban Kekerasan.  
17. Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat UPTD PPA adalah unit pelayanan terpadu yang dibentuk oleh Pemerintah Daerah untuk memberikan Pelayanan kepada Perempuan Korban Kekerasan dan anak secara komprehensif meliputi pelayanan layanan pengaduan, rehabilitasi kesehatan, rehabilitasi sosial , pemulangan, reintegrasi sosial, dan bantuan hukum.  
18. Standar Pelayanan Minimal yang selanjutnya disingkat SPM adalah tolak ukur kinerja pelayanan UPTD PPA dalam memberikan pelayanan layanan pengaduan, rehabilitasi kesehatan, rehabilitasi sosial, pemulangan, reintegrasi sosial, dan bantuan hukum bagi Perempuan Korban Kekerasan dan anak.  
19. Rumah Aman adalah tempat tinggal sementara, yang diberikan untuk memberikan perlindungan terhadap Perempuan Korban Kekerasan sesuai dengan standar yang telah ditentukan.  

Pasal2 Peraturan Daerah ini dilaksanakan berdasarkan asas:
a. penghormatan terhadap hak asasi manusia;  
b. keadilan dan kesetaraan gender;  
c. Non ...

##### BUPATI KUTAI TIMUR

##### PROVINSI KALIMANTAN TIMUR

6-
c. non diskriminasi; dand. kepentingan terbaik perempuan.  

Pasal3 Peraturan Daerah ini bertujuan untuk:
a. menjamin terpenuhinya hak-hak perempuan agar dapat hidup dan berpartisipasi secara optimal sesuai dengan harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan;  
b. mencegah segala bentuk Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan;  
c. memberikan perlindungan dan rasa aman bagi perempuan korban kekerasan dan diskriminasisi;  
d. menjamin terlaksananya kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan perlindungan perempuan oleh daerah secara sistemis, komprehensif, berkesinambungan, dan terpad u;  
e. meningkatkan komitmen Pemerintah Daerah dalam melaksanakan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan perlindungan perempuan; danf. mendorong kelembagaan yang menangani tugas dan fungsi pemberdayaan perempuan di Pemerintah Daerah maupun lembaga masyarakat di daerah untuk meningkatkan kinerja dalam upaya perlindungan perempuan.

a. hak-hak perempuan korban kekerasan;  
b. kewenangan Pemerintah Daerah;  
c. perencanaan;  
d. Pelaksanaan ...

# CONCERNING

# PROTECTION OF WOMEN

# BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

THE REGENT OF EAST KUTAI,
a. that every woman has the right to protection of her person, family, honor, dignity, and property under her control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from threats of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right;  
b. that to provide one guideline or reference for regional governments and related stakeholders regarding the improvement of women's quality of life and protection of women, especially for women victims of violence;  
c. that to provide direction, foundation and legal certainty to all parties involved in the empowerment of women and children, it is necessary to regulate the establishment of an Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children;  
d. that based on the considerations as referred to in letters a through c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Protection of Women;

# HAS DECIDED:

To Establish A REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN.

# CHAPTER I

## GENERAL PROVISIONS

#### Article 1

In this regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is East Kutai Regency.  
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region of East Kutai Regency.  
3. Regent is the Regent of East Kutai.  
4. Agency is the Agency for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection of East Kutai Regency.  
5. Village is a legal community unit that has territorial boundaries authorized to regulate and manage government affairs, the interests of the local community based on community initiative, rights of origin and/or traditional rights that are recognized and respected in the government system of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia.  
6. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman.  
7. Protection . . .

##### REGENT OF EAST KUTAI

##### EAST KALIMANTAN PROVINCE

4-

7. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.  
8. Service is all efforts and actions to fulfill the rights of victims which include complaint services, health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance.  
9. Violence Against Women is any action that violates, hinders, eliminates enjoyment, and neglects the human rights of women.  
10. Women Victims of Violence are women who experience acts of violence and discrimination whose rights are not fulfilled.  
11. Health Rehabilitation is the recovery of Women Victims of violence from the health disorders they suffer.  
12. Social Rehabilitation is all efforts to restore and develop the abilities of Women Victims of Violence so that they can carry out their social roles and functions both in family life and/or society.  
13. Repatriation is an effort to return Women Victims of Violence to the family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.  
14. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite Women Victims of Violence with the family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfill the needs of victims.  
15. Legal Assistance ...

##### REGENT OF EAST KUTAI

##### EAST KALIMANTAN PROVINCE

5-

15. Legal Assistance is legal services provided by legal assistants and advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or Women Victims of Violence.  
16. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is a functional work unit that organizes integrated services for Women Victims of Violence.  
17. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is an integrated service unit established by the Regional Government to provide Services to Women Victims of Violence and children comprehensively including complaint services, health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance.  
18. Minimum Service Standards hereinafter abbreviated as SPM is a performance benchmark for UPTD PPA services in providing complaint services, health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance for Women Victims of Violence and children.  
19. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection for Women Victims of Violence in accordance with predetermined standards.  

Article 2 This Regional Regulation is implemented based on the principles of:
a. respect for human rights;  
b. justice and gender equality;  
c. Non ...

##### REGENT OF EAST KUTAI

##### EAST KALIMANTAN PROVINCE

6-
c. non-discrimination; andd. the best interests of women.  

Article 3 This Regional Regulation aims to:
a. guarantee the fulfillment of women's rights so that they can live and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity;  
b. prevent all forms of Violence against Women;  
c. provide protection and a sense of security for women victims of violence and discrimination;  
d. guarantee the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women by the region in a systematic, comprehensive, sustainable, and integrated manner;  
e. increase the commitment of the Regional Government in implementing policies, programs and activities for the protection of women; andf. encourage institutions that handle the duties and functions of women's empowerment in the Regional Government and community institutions in the region to improve performance in efforts to protect women.  

Article 4 The scope of this Regional Regulation includes:
a. the rights of women victims of violence;  
b. the authority of the Regional Government;  
c. planning;  
d. Implementation ...

# CHAPTER VI

## MONITORING AND EVALUATION

## PROTECTIONOFWOMEN

## 1. GENERAL

Protection of women is important because women are a vulnerable or subordinated group, particularly in connection with the many cases of violence against women who become victims.

Furthermore, in the National Action Plan for the Elimination of Violence against Women of 1999, it is stated that women as mothers of the nation and children as successors of the nation are creatures created by God Almighty, so they must be protected and their honor, dignity and self-esteem must be safeguarded in a reasonable and proportional manner, both legally, economically, politically, socially and culturally without distinguishing ethnicity, religion, race and class.

Although efforts have been made to protect women and there are also government policies through laws and regulations that have firmly formulated efforts for the protection of women, including efforts to protect women victims of violence, in reality the intensity or number of violence against women in East Kutai Regency is still high while services and protection for women in East Kutai Regency have not been carried out optimally. Empirically in East Kutai Regency, an important factor that has influenced the process of prevention and protection of women so far is that in existing laws and regulations, procedures and mechanisms for prevention and protection are not firmly regulated.
